notes.title: Think_ Live: Chat with MaxPI!
notes.content:
[h1]Wanna talk?[/h1]
Hi, I'm MaxPI.
I'm an independent game developer and in this stream, I'll be chatting with my viewers about whatever you like.
Wanna talk about depression? Sure thing.
Life? Game developing? Other games? My own game? We can chat about practically everything.

[h1]What are you going to show?[/h1]
I'll be playing Think_ mainly, I'll show new parts of the game and I'll also play other games if they'll fit the discussion.

[h3]So, what are you waiting for? Join us![/h3]
